title: Exterior Styling and Design
summary: Sampled feedback about the G60's exterior styling is largely favorable, with many reviewers explicitly liking the look while some mentions refer to styling without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the G60's exterior look and styling design as appealing, good, and one of the vehicle's most liked attributes.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention styling or exterior design without enough detail to tell whether the customer view is favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: The sampled fragments are very short and repetitive, so they provide limited detail about which specific design elements customers liked.
Only one model appears in this topic, so the summary is limited to the G60.
Several examples are bare mentions of styling without explicit sentiment, which limits interpretation of those comments.
